I was lucky to receive FISP coupons this season, so I will buy NPK and urea from the ADMARC depot to apply on my main maize plot. I will plant the hybrid maize seed that comes with the program because it gives better yields than the local seed I used to keep. We do not spray chemicals on food crops here in Ntcheu, and there is no water for irrigation, so my family will do most of the work ourselves, though I may hire a few day-laborers to help with weeding when the rains come.
